description: The >>FLAG-85 migration-flagging directive - a compiler-directive WINDOW: introduced with the §2023:7.3 facility in COBOL-2002, classified obsolete by the 2014 standard and REMOVED in COBOL-2023. Annex E.2 item 21 ('Obsolete elements') is the removal record: 'The following features that were classified as obsolete in the previous COBOL standard, have been removed from this Working Draft International Standard: - FLAG-85 - FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC - Standard Arithmetic - ...', which fixes removedIn=2023 and, by 'classified as obsolete in the previous COBOL standard', obsoleteIn=2014. The 2023 text carries NO general format for this directive; the 2002 and 2014 texts print it (§2002:7.2.11.1), and the row's operand is that format, diagnosed and acted on by FlagDirectiveProcessor + FlagConformancePass (kb/Work PB5600). The introducedIn edge rides the same M2-catalog derivation as its sibling arithmetic-standard-2002 (Annex E.2 item 21's other leg; VCR row 28). Below 2002 the word is COBOL0900, at 2023 COBOL0902, at 2014 the COBOL0903 obsolete warning.
citation: Annex E.2 item 21 (removed in 2023, classified obsolete by the previous standard); the §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction (M2 catalog derivation, VCR Table 7 discipline)

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2002:7.2.11.1 general format (a list of syntax-option words, or ALL, with ON/OFF; §2002:7.2.11.3 GR4 names the options) — a structured operand, diagnosed by its own stage as COBOL1622. The 2023 text carries no clause (Annex E.2 item 21 removed the directive); the 2002 and 2014 texts print the format.

vcr: VCR row 28 (Annex E.2 item 21 removal) + the §2023:7.3 facility's 2002 introduction
source:
>>FLAG-85 ALL ON
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725F8.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.

directivePlacement.text: The FLAG-85 directive may be specified only between clauses in divisions other than the procedure division and only between statements in the procedure division
